limitations: Nonempty finite simple threshold graphs in pure counting-free adjacency and equality; variable widths at least three. No assertion for all cographs, one- or two-variable fragments, or counting logic. Older papers with uncertain first-public calendar day are cited without fabricating a date; historical priority remains qualified.
scientific_integrity: Mathematical theorem with detailed direct proof and two reproducible finite checks. Finite computation is corroboration, not a proof for unbounded graph sizes or quantifier depths.
title: Exact unrestricted variable-width theories of finite threshold graphs
